Exercise: Anti-Gravity Press

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- shoulder_press_variation

Primary Muscles:

- shoulders

Secondary Muscles:

- middle back
- traps
- triceps

Equipment:

- barbell

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- develop_shoulder_strength_and_size
- improve_overall_upper_body_stability

Contraindications:

- Shoulder instability or injury
- Rotator cuff issues

Exercise Variations:

- name: Arnold Press, equipment: barbell
- name: Barbell Upright Row, equipment: barbell

Substitution Options:

- name: Overhead Press, equipment: dumbbells

Instructions:

- Place a bar on the ground behind the head of an incline bench.
- Lay on the bench face down. With a pronated grip, pick the barbell up from the floor. Flex the elbows, performing a reverse curl to bring the bar near your chest. This will be your starting position.
- To begin, press the barbell out in front of your head by extending your elbows. Keep your arms parallel to the ground throughout the movement.
- Return to the starting position and repeat to complete the set.
